title: Released row-3213 conditional diagnostic
faithful_claim: Riess v3 compares an anchor with a fit omitting its geometric constraint but retaining its Cepheids. This candidate instead proposes a conditional density for supplied row3213 under frozen released products. It does not claim source-equivalent Fit15 or an independent heldout prediction.

equations.definitions: Z_joint and Z_train include each Gaussian observation-density normalization and the identical normalized prior. Both use the frozen source-derived box; no proper-Gaussian prior substitution. log density is log Z_joint−log Z_train.

data_dependencies.fullfit_prior: README line6 and run_mcmc/MCMC_utils use lstsq full-fit centers/widths; retaining this box makes the heldout diagnostic conditional on full-fit information.
data_dependencies.MW_summary: Riessv3 §4.1 pp23–24 uses global b,Z in parallax-derived zeropoint summaries; a true source refit must update or justify freezing them.
data_dependencies.background_and_covariance: Riessv3 p20 item2/Eq8 iterative trial P–L calibration and within-host covariance floor; relation or selection change may alter both y and C.
data_dependencies.selection: Baseline clipping uses global-fit residuals, p38 §6.1; no unclipped/outlier/refit-selection release examined here.
data_dependencies.artificial_star_uncertainty: table2.tex line3143 explicitly warns new selections may necessitate new simulations. No new photometric selection is made by this formal diagnostic, but physical refit/selection independence cannot be inferred.
